candidates: [TECH] When assessing sharpness or detail, do not reward excessive noise or unnatural texture enhancement if it compromises the subject’s appearance or realism.
[AESTH] When evaluating color and lighting, prioritize visual harmony and emotional impact over mere vibrancy or contrast.
[CONTENT] If the subject is obscured or distorted by foreground elements or shallow depth-of-field, score lower for content clarity even if technical metrics are high.
[NATURAL] When an image appears overly processed or artificial (e.g., unnatural skin tones, blown highlights), downgrade its overall quality regardless of technical perfection.
[GLOBAL] Always consider the entire image as a unified whole—do not isolate dimensions like “color” or “sharpness” if they conflict with overall perceptual quality.
